name: Register workplace
description: Create or reuse a workplace (local path, SSH host, or tunnel label) and optionally assign it to the current agent for this turn. Use when the user names a server path or machine to work on.

function.name: register_workplace
function.description: Register a workplace. For local debugging: kind=local and path=/abs/path. Sets the workplace for subsequent tools in this turn when use_now is true.

assign_to_agent.description: Add workplace to the current agent (default true).

use_now.description: Bind this workplace for the rest of the turn (default true).
